summary.text: Megan Cotter is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 39 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election she faces Republican Jasmin Roy.

paragraphs.text: Megan Cotter was born in Providence, Rhode Island, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Rhode Island in 2008, and has career experience working as a sales manager.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Rhode Islander, a mother and a wife, and said she believes in fiscal responsibility and transparent government.

She said her campaign priorities include policies to reduce electric bills, higher Medicaid reimbursement rates to retain physicians and other health care workers, and forest management to reduce wildfire risk.
